title: Oxform
description: Oxform is a framework-agnostic form library for TypeScript. A form is a chain of extensions on defineForm, and each extension adds options, state, an api and slots. An adapter turns the slots of a form into parts for React, Solid 1 or Solid 2. Each link below opens the Markdown form of one page, in sidebar order. /llms-full.txt has the text of every page in one file.
